build_make_sequence_features: build a function that constructs a feature dictionary from a protein sequence string and description
build_make_mmcif_features: build a function that extracts structural features from an mmCIF object and returns a biomolecule assembly
build_make_msa_features: build a function that constructs MSA feature dictionaries from multiple sequence alignments per chain
build_make_template_features: build a function that extracts template features by aligning PDB templates to query sequences with kalign
build_merge_chain_features: build a function that merges MSA chain features from multiple chains with optional paired MSA concatenation
